programs.title: A Working Man
programs.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programs.title: Peacemaker 2
programs.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programs.title: Venom
programs.desc: Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) is an ambitious investigative journalist who, thanks to his determination, always achieves his goal.However, when one of his missions - exposing the unethical activities of the Life Foundation - turns into an obsession, Eddie loses his job and breaks up with his fiancée Anne (Michelle Williams).Weakened, he accidentally enters into a symbiosis with an alien - the fruit of the experiments of the company owner, the sinister millionaire Calton Drake (Riz Ahmed).The journalist and the alien together create a powerful and bloodthirsty monster.Eddie must find a way out of the situation before a dangerous monster takes him completely over.Meanwhile, Drake follows the reporter's trail and wants to get his property back.The comic Venom was created years ago by David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane.

programs.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programs.desc: Student Stefani (Kaitlyn Santa Juana) is plagued by nightmares about her grandparents.In their dreams, they die along with other people in the Skyview skyscraper in 1969.Although such an event never happened, the girl decides to investigate the cause of her visions.To do this, he returns to his hometown, Cloverdale.She is greeted there by her father, Marty (Tinpo Lee), and younger brother, Charlie (Teo Briones).Stefani begins searching for Iris (Brec Bassinger), the grandmother she sees in her nightmares and who has broken off contact with her family.To do this, he visits his Uncle Howard (Alex Zahara) and Aunt Brenda (April Telek).Thanks to the letters found among them, he reaches a woman (Gabrielle Rose) who is dying of cancer and lives in a remote area.She tells her that the skyscraper did not collapse only thanks to her vision and earlier intervention.At the same time, he warns that from that day on, death has haunted everyone who died in the disaster, and even the descendants of the would-be victims.As she dies, her words quickly come true.Stefani wants to save her relatives from the gruesome death that inevitably awaits them.The sixth installment of the series launched in 2000.

programs.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programs.desc: Paris, 1930s. The son of immigrants takes part in a theater performance.This is how he discovers his vocal talent and decides to become a singer.A breakthrough in his career was his meeting with Edith Piaf.
